title: Above the Average
summary:
Above the Average
The long-term health of the tanker market in general is driven by underlying fundamentals such as demand for crude oil and products, but the day-to-day relationship between supply and demand for ships drives rate volatility. The regional balance of available ships versus their demand can trigger sharp peaks and troughs in rates depending on requirements of particular trades. The trend over the long-term has been that of increased volatility in rates.
